about: Argus section catalogue, navigation and footer patterns, from research/layout-grids-components.md. family is the layout family: the dealer never puts two sections of one family next to each other. A navigation role is main (the header pattern), phone (the phone pattern that goes with any main one) or addition (an extra bar). structure: the shape of the section (ruled-list, sticky-steps, rail, timeline, gallery, stat-row, marquee, comparison, board, drawn-diagram, labels...); directions are dealt different shapes, and recently built ones are leaned away from. avoid: kinds of business a section is wrong for; never dealt to them. loud: never dealt with --tone calm.

sections.name: Index strip / contents
sections.layout: Numbered rows across the full width with a hairline rule between each; numeral, title and a short line at fixed x-positions.
sections.generic: Pill tabs, or a row of equal buttons.
sections.designed: 01-0n numerals; hovering or focusing a row shows a preview picture anchored to the row.
sections.phone: Rows stay full width; the preview becomes a thumbnail at the row end.

sections.name: Oversized numbered list
sections.layout: 3-5 items, each numeral 8-14rem across a 3-column span, text in 6 columns.
sections.generic: Three icon cards in a row.
sections.designed: Numerals that crop at the section edge or overlap the rule.
sections.phone: Numerals drop to about 5rem above each item.

sections.name: Sticky media split
sections.layout: Media sticky in 5 columns beside steps in 7, steps 50-70vh apart. Only when each step changes what the media shows; a sequence that does not is a numbered list, a rail or one drawing.
sections.generic: A sticky picture with an empty tail under it.
sections.designed: The media changes state with each step and the list ends as the media does.
sections.phone: The media sits above each step at a small size, or becomes one picture per step.

sections.name: Horizontal process track
sections.layout: A scroll-snap rail of steps, each a picture of that step with a short caption, and a progress hairline; steps that are only text stay a numbered column (motion.md, M27).
sections.generic: Carousel arrows and dots.
sections.designed: A visible "3/6" counter and about 15% of the next card peeking in.
sections.phone: Stays a rail with a peek when each step is a picture; text-only steps stack as a numbered list.

sections.name: Editorial comparison table
sections.layout: Label column of 3 columns, values in large type, rules only.
sections.generic: A tick and cross grid.
sections.designed: Few rows, a sentence per cell, one highlighted column.
sections.phone: One column per screen with a switcher, or rows that become stacked label/value pairs.

sections.name: Price board
sections.layout: A menu or departure-board list with leader dots or a tabular-figure price column.
sections.generic: Three tier cards.
sections.designed: One row per product with the total shown; tabular figures aligned.
sections.phone: Rows keep leaders; long names wrap above the price.

sections.name: Timeline
sections.layout: A vertical spine on a column line; dates in the label size in the margin.
sections.generic: Alternating left-right cards with dots.
sections.designed: Real dates with pictures sized by importance.
sections.phone: Spine moves to the left edge; dates sit above each entry.

sections.name: Map with list
sections.layout: List in 4 columns, map in 8 at full height; hovering a list item highlights its pin.
sections.generic: An embedded map beside an address block.
sections.designed: Hours and "open now" in the list; a drawn map in the page's colours.
sections.phone: Map on top at 50vh, list below, tapping an item moves the map.

sections.name: Before/after slider
sections.layout: Full-bleed paired photographs with a draggable divider.
sections.generic: A small slider in a card.
sections.designed: The handle uses the motif; keyboard operable with arrow keys.
sections.phone: Full width; the handle is large enough for a thumb.

sections.name: Logo wall
sections.layout: 4-6 logos in one colour at about 24-32px cap height on a ruled grid.
sections.generic: Twenty grey logos in a marquee.
sections.designed: Few logos, each with a short line on what was done.
sections.phone: Two columns of logos; lines under each.

sections.name: Full-bleed quote
sections.layout: A 4-6rem quote across 10 columns, with a hanging open-quote in the margin and the name in the label size.
sections.generic: A card with stars and an avatar circle.
sections.designed: One quote, big, with a real name, role and date.
sections.phone: Quote at 2-2.5rem; the hanging mark moves inside.

sections.name: Review wall
sections.layout: Masonry (grid-lanes with a columns fallback) of quotes at different lengths and type sizes.
sections.generic: Identical star cards in a row.
sections.designed: Quotes of real lengths, sizes set by importance, sources named.
sections.phone: One column, the strongest three quotes first, then "more".

sections.name: Marquee
sections.layout: One line in display type crawling across the width, pausable; at most one per page.
sections.generic: A logo strip or a row of buzzwords.
sections.designed: A real sentence or list (today's menu, dates) with a pause control.
sections.phone: Smaller type, same crawl, pause stays.

sections.name: Gallery mosaic
sections.layout: A 12-column grid with pictures spanning 7/5, then 4/8, captions in the margin.
sections.generic: An even grid of squares.
sections.designed: Varied spans that repeat x-positions; captions beside the picture edge.
sections.phone: A rail with a peek, or single pictures with captions under them.

sections.name: Stat band
sections.layout: 2-3 figures at display size with their sources.
sections.generic: Four tiles with sparklines and count-ups.
sections.designed: Figures that matter, set large, each with a source line.
sections.phone: Figures stack, each still large.

sections.name: FAQ, split variant
sections.layout: Question list in 7 columns, sticky contact or a review in 5.
sections.generic: A centred accordion of ten questions.
sections.designed: Real questions in the customer's words; the side panel answers "still unsure?".
sections.phone: Accordion full width; the contact panel follows the list.

sections.name: FAQ, index variant
sections.layout: Questions as a contents list that jumps to the answers set as a column below.
sections.generic: An accordion.
sections.designed: Answers readable without clicking; the index works as navigation.
sections.phone: Index collapses into a details element at the top.

sections.name: Team as names list
sections.layout: Names in display size in a list; hovering or focusing a name shows a portrait anchored to the row.
sections.generic: Round headshots in a grid with job titles.
sections.designed: Names large, roles small, the portrait shown on demand.
sections.phone: Names with a small portrait beside each.

sections.name: Configurator
sections.layout: Options in a left rail, the result large, a sticky total.
sections.generic: A long form of dropdowns.
sections.designed: The result picture changes with each option; the total is always in view.
sections.phone: Result on top, options in a bottom sheet, total in a sticky bar.

sections.name: Calculator
sections.layout: A sentence with inputs inside it ("I invoice £[ ] a month"); the result at display size.
sections.generic: A form with labelled boxes and a result card.
sections.designed: The sentence reads naturally; the result is the biggest thing.
sections.phone: The sentence wraps; inputs stay inline and large enough to tap.

sections.name: Spec sheet
sections.layout: A 2-column definition list with rules and tabular figures, like a data plate.
sections.generic: Icons with feature names.
sections.designed: Real numbers and units, aligned, with the most important row larger.
sections.phone: One column of label/value pairs.

sections.name: Material/ingredient breakdown
sections.layout: A big photograph with anchored callouts drawn over it.
sections.generic: A list of ingredients beside a picture.
sections.designed: Callout lines in the kit's drawing style, anchored to the real parts.
sections.phone: The picture stays; callouts become a numbered list under it with numbers on the picture.

sections.name: Day in the life
sections.layout: Horizontal hours, each a picture plus a timestamp.
sections.generic: A grid of stock lifestyle photos.
sections.designed: Real times and real moments in order.
sections.phone: A rail with a peek and a time scale.

sections.name: Founder letter
sections.layout: One 65ch column of serif text, a signature, date and place, on a different ground.
sections.generic: A "Our story" heading with a stock team photo.
sections.designed: A real voice, short, signed; a different ground marks it off.
sections.phone: Same column at body size.

sections.name: Press strip
sections.layout: Quote fragments with masthead names in their own small caps.
sections.generic: Grey press logos in a row.
sections.designed: A few words each, the masthead named, linked to the piece.
sections.phone: Stacked fragments.

sections.name: Newsletter block
sections.layout: One inline field inside a sentence, with what you get and how often.
sections.generic: A centred "Subscribe to our newsletter" box.
sections.designed: What arrives and how often, said plainly; one field.
sections.phone: Field below the sentence, full width.

sections.name: Location/hours block
sections.layout: Address, today's hours highlighted and a live "open until 7", beside a picture of the door.
sections.generic: A footer-style address list.
sections.designed: Today first, live state, the real entrance pictured.
sections.phone: Live state first, then hours, then the picture.

sections.name: Lookbook/edition index
sections.layout: A fixed numbered rail beside a large live preview of the selected item.
sections.generic: A product grid.
sections.designed: Numbered items, one large at a time, the rail as navigation.
sections.phone: The rail becomes a horizontal strip of numbers above the preview.

sections.name: Category tiles as type
sections.layout: Category words at display size; hovering shows an image.
sections.generic: Image cards with labels.
sections.designed: The words are the navigation; the image appears on demand.
sections.phone: Words stacked with a small image beside each.

sections.name: Process as checklist
sections.layout: The real document (a job sheet, a form) filled in as the page scrolls.
sections.generic: Four numbered steps with icons.
sections.designed: The real artefact of the trade, filled in step by step.
sections.phone: The document stays; items tick as they enter the screen.

sections.name: Guarantee/terms block
sections.layout: A short numbered set of plain-language terms.
sections.generic: A shield icon with "100% satisfaction".
sections.designed: Real terms, numbered, signed off by a person.
sections.phone: Same list, full width.

sections.name: Figures inside a sentence
sections.layout: Two or three figures set inside a sentence of running text at a larger size, each with its source in a note.
sections.generic: A row of four count-up stats.
sections.designed: The figures read as a claim in words, so each has a reason to be there.
sections.phone: The sentence wraps; figures stay inline.

sections.name: One photograph with a long caption
sections.layout: One photograph at the content width with a caption set like a museum label beside or below it: what it is, where, who made it.
sections.generic: A carousel of five similar pictures.
sections.designed: The one best picture, large, and a caption worth reading.
sections.phone: The caption sits under the picture.

sections.name: The trade's own labels
sections.layout: The items set as the printed things this trade really uses (tickets, tags, receipts, jar labels, seed packets) at their real proportions, in a loose row; each carries its real fields.
sections.generic: A grid of three equal product cards.
sections.designed: Real fields (batch, date, weight, price) in the label's own layout; one shape used throughout.
sections.phone: Labels stack at full width or sit in a swipeable row, each whole.

sections.name: One object, several states
sections.layout: One object shown in three or four states down or across the section (raw, worked, finished; booked, repaired, collected), each state with its one line.
sections.generic: A numbered process with icons.
sections.designed: The same object drawn or photographed from one angle in each state, so the change is what you see.
sections.phone: States stack, each picture still whole, or become a swipeable row.

sections.name: Drawn explainer
sections.layout: A line drawing made for the subject (how it works, its parts, the route) across the content width, with labels set as real text beside the parts they name.
sections.generic: Three icon cards in a row.
sections.designed: One stroke language, labels anchored to the real parts, the drawing completes once as it arrives (svg snippets: techniques to redraw).
sections.phone: The drawing stays whole at full width; labels become a numbered list under it with numbers on the drawing.

sections.name: CTA finale
sections.layout: The promise set large, the action with its reassurance line, and the practical details (hours, address, contact).
sections.generic: A centred heading and button on a gradient.
sections.designed: The last screen closes the argument: the action, one live fact, and a picture or the product.
sections.phone: Promise at 15vw, action full width.

sections.name: Mega footer
sections.layout: Sitemap columns, live hours, address with map link, newsletter and a colophon (fonts, photo credits, "set in").
sections.generic: Four columns of links and social icons.
sections.designed: Live details and a colophon that names the faces and photographers.
sections.phone: Columns become details elements; live details first.

navigation.name: Corner nav
navigation.layout: Four corners carry name, menu, basket and time or place.
navigation.phone: Name and menu stay in the top corners; the rest moves into the menu.

navigation.name: Split nav
navigation.layout: Links left, wordmark centred, utilities right.
navigation.phone: Wordmark centred, menu and basket at the sides.

navigation.name: Rail nav
navigation.layout: A fixed left index that doubles as contents.
navigation.phone: Becomes a horizontal strip of numbers or a bottom sheet.

navigation.name: Full-screen menu
navigation.layout: A large type list with an image preview on hover, two columns with contact details; popover plus @starting-style.
navigation.phone: The same list at a smaller size; contact details first.

navigation.name: Morph on scroll
navigation.layout: Full header at the top, a compact pill once stuck (scroll-state query with an IntersectionObserver fallback).

navigation.name: Bottom bar on phones
navigation.layout: 3-4 items in thumb reach, or a single sticky action bar ("Book - Wed 2 Dec").
navigation.phone: This is the phone pattern; desktop uses a split or corner nav.

navigation.name: Command palette
navigation.layout: A search-first palette opened by a key and a button.
navigation.phone: A search button that opens a full-screen sheet.

navigation.name: Announcement bar
navigation.layout: One line with real information (dispatch cutoff, opening times), dismissible, 32-40px.
navigation.phone: One short line; truncates with the full text on tap.

footers.name: Footer as finale
footers.layout: Display-size name, the action, live details (hours, address, dispatch times), then a sitemap and a colophon.

footers.name: Full sitemap footer
footers.layout: Sitemap columns, policy links, newsletter and a colophon; the shop pattern.

footers.name: Colophon footer
footers.layout: One line of name and year, a short colophon naming the faces and photographers, one contact link.

footers.name: Contact sheet footer
footers.layout: Address, phone, hours today and a map link set large as the last screen.
